pages.markdown:
* Smart Cash Plan is a product that offers daily cash benefit to the insured for each completed and consecutive 24 hours of hospitalisation due to sickness or accident. This product is not a substitute for Health Insurance but a supplement to Health Insurance covering out of pocket expenses associated with sickness/accidental hospitalization like special diet, conveyance expenses to the Hospital and back, expenses incurred by a family member staying with the patient and so on.
  * ## Q2. How is Smart Cash Plan different from Health Insurance?
  * Health Insurance reimburses inpatient hospital bills. Smart Cash Plan offers you fixed daily benefits per every completed and consecutive 24 hours spent in hospital. This is aimed in covering the incidental expenses during hospitalisation which are normally not covered under health insurance. Smart Cash Plan Insurance is NOT a substitute of Health Insurance. Rather it acts as a supplement.
  * ## Q3. How is Smart Cash plan different from other existing daily cash policies?
  * Among other benefits, Smart Cash Plan offers higher daily benefit, worldwide coverage, 180 days cover, variety of plans to choose, various special benefits like Critical illness benefit etc. to name a few.
  * ## Q4. What is the age limit for availing Smart Cash Plan?
  * The required entry age for an adult is minimum 18 yrs. and that of children is 91 days of age. While there is no maximum entry age under a Silver plan, the maximum entry age for Gold and Platinum plans is upto 70 years. The proposer should be minimum 18 years (completed age) on Policy Start Date. The policy is renewable lifelong.
  * To make a claim, inform our customer support about hospitalisation. We will forward you the Claim Form. You can also download it from our website.
You need to submit the duly filled Claim Form with requisite documents within 30 days from the date of discharge.
  * ## Q6. If a family member covered by the Insurance is hospitalised, to whom will the benefit be paid?
  * ## Q7. How will the cash be paid? How frequently will it be paid?
  * This Insurance plan includes cash benefit. The payment will be made by way of cheque for period of hospitalisation found admissible after we receive the completed Claim Form with supporting documents, which is to be submitted within 30 days after discharge. Additional benefits if applicable shall also be paid along with the claim settlement.
  * Yes. This is a pre-requisite. Hence, unless the insured person is hospitalized for a condition warranting hospitalisation, no claim is payable under this policy.
  * ## Q9. How many days of benefit will be covered by the policy for instance if a person is hospitalised on 10th May and discharged on 20th May?
  * Every consecutive and completed 24 hours shall be counted as a day. Hence the time of admission and time of discharge are crucial to decide on count of days for claim settlement. In the example under reference, if the person was admitted at 5 pm on 10th May and discharged at 10 am on 20th May, then 9 days of hospitalisation shall be considered for claim admissibility.
  * ## Q10. What happens when I have to undergo a procedure like Dialysis, and got discharged on the same day?
  * Daily benefit is not payable in this case, as there is no complete 24 hours of hospitalisation. However, if the stay exceeds 24 hours due to complications arising out of the procedure, the claim is admissible. Please also note that daily benefit for day care procedures is not covered under the policy.
  * ## Q11. Do I need a Health Insurance Policy to avail Smart Cash Plan?
  * No, you need not have a Health Insurance Policy to avail Smart Cash Plan. However, it is prudent to cover your loved ones and let not medical expense affect your savings.
  * ## Q12. I already have a Health Insurance Policy with another Insurance company. Can I avail Royal Sundaram's Smart Cash Plan?
  * A lump sum benefit amount of ₹ 10000/- and ₹ 20000/- is payable under Gold and Platinum Plan respectively in the event of hospitalisation resulting in Child Birth.
  * ## Q14. What is the coverage provided under pre-existing disease benefit?
  * A chosen daily benefit or ₹ 5000/- whichever is lower is payable under Gold & Platinum plans for a maximum of 5 days per policy year for hospitalisation due to pre-existing diseases.
  * Under this benefit, when a claim is admissible under critical illness benefit for insured parents, spouse or children, the flight ticket charges incurred for emergency travel from abroad to India up to a maximum of ₹ 1 lakh is payable per person per policy year. This benefit is available only for Platinum plan customers.
  * Yes. Smart Cash plan operates worldwide for Personal Accident benefit. Further Hospital Confinement Benefit stands extended when unexpected hospitalisation happens whilst on a trip abroad on an official or a holiday visit.
  *     * Disease contracted during the first 30 days of commencement of policy
    * Certain treatment/diseases/procedures during first year of policy such as: Congenital Internal Diseases, Cataract, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy Hysterectomy, Knee / Hip Joint replacement. These are covered from subsequent renewals
    * Convalescence, general debility, `Run-down’ condition or rest cure, Congenital External Disease or defects or anomalies, Venereal disease, intentional self injury or attempted suicide
    * Treatment of obesity and any other weight control programs, services or supplies
    * Treatment of psychiatric and psychosomatic disorders, mental or nervous conditions, insanity.
For more detailed information about the coverage and exclusions, please refer the
  * ## Q18. Do I have to undergo any medical tests to avail the Policy?
  * Yes. Persons who are above 60 years of age who opt for platinum plan or who request for conversion from existing plan to another plan, may be required to submit their medical examination reports. Following shall be the medical tests required:Mandatory MER, HBA1C, ECG Printout, Lipid Profile, Hb, S.Creatinine, Liver Function Tests will have to be submitted. These reports should be dated not prior to 30 days from the date of requisitioning. For accepted proposals, the cost of medical check-up undertaken shall be reimbursed by the Company @ 100% for policies with more than 1 year tenure and @ 50% for policies with tenure of 1 year.
  * ## Q19. Is there any other benefit of availing Smart Cash Plan?
  * Yes. You can get a relief on your Income Tax under section 80 D, Income Tax Act 1961.
  * ## Q20. If I wish to cancel my Policy, will I get a refund for the same?
  * If for any reason you wish to opt out of the Insurance, the premium for the period at risk shall be retained as per the short period rates and balance shall be refunded. No refund shall happen on policies where a claim is notified or settled. Please refer to our Terms and Conditions page for more information on this.

pages.markdown:
* ## Q1. How do I view or get my SBI Card statement?
  * The following are the three modes of credit card statements:
    * Online statement - You can view and download your credit card statement online, by logging into . You can choose the 'e-statement' option to get statement on your email ID. You can View / Print / Download your statements for the latest 24 months and/ or from the date of registration, whichever is recent. Alternatively, you can Login to Chatbot ILA and ask query to view/ get SBI Card Statement.
  * You can view your credit card statement online, in 3 easy steps.
    * STEP 2: Click on "My Accounts" at the left hand side.
You can View / Print / Download your Statements for latest 24 months and/ or from the date of registration, whichever is recent.
Alternatively, you can Login to Chatbot ILA and ask query to view your SBI Card Statement.
  * You can instantly download last 24 months’ statement in PDF format from our website sbicard.com. It is free of charge.
    * STEP 3: Select the statement date of required month from the list of archived statements
Log in to Chatbot ILA and follow these steps:-
    * Step1 : Ask query “How can I download my card statement? ”
    * Step2 : Select the required month from the list of archived statements and Click on ‘Submit’
  * ## Q4. How can I place a request for duplicate statement?
  * You can place a request for duplicate statement either on the website or SBI Card Mobile App or Chatbot ILA or SMS.
    * STEP 1: Login to Chatbot ILA using the same User ID and password used for sbicard website.
    * STEP 2: Ask query “How can I get a duplicate statement?”
    * STEP 3: Select the required month from the list of archived statements and Click on ‘Submit’
    * STEP 2: Click on "Requests" on the left hand side
    * STEP 4: Select the required month from the list of archived statements
    * STEP 1: Login to sbicard mobile app using the same User ID and password used for sbicard website.
    * STEP 2: Click on "Menu Tab" on the top left hand side
    * STEP 3: Click on "Service Request" then Click on “More” , select Duplicate Statement.
    * STEP 4: Select the required month from the list of archived statements
Simply SMS “DSTMT XXXX MM” from your registered mobile number to 5676791, where XXXX is the last four digits of your credit card & MM is the month of the required statement.Once the request is placed, you will receive an e-statement in your email within 3 calendar days and physical statement will reach you in 10 calendar days via postal services.
Kindly note that original statements are issued only once for a specific billing period. Subsequently, only a duplicate copy is issued for that billing period basis customer request.
  * ## Q5. I have not received my monthly credit card statement, what can I do?
  * Physical statements are dispatched and delivered within 10 calendar days from the date of generation of statement via available delivery mode. I.e. Courier/ Postal. If you have not received your Monthly Credit Card Statement, then we request you to check if the address provided by you is correct on our records. You can do so by logging on to sbicard.com Online and going to 'My Profile' and then by clicking “Address” section. Please check the communication address registered with us.
In case of change in address, we request you to update it online. Click here to view demo to learn how to change address online. If there is no change in your address, please write to us at sbicard.com/email or Call us at helpline at 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD code) or 1860 180 1290
Statement on email will be delivered to your registered email id within 3 calendar days from the date of generation. If you are not in receipt of your email statement, kindly verify your junk / spam folder as the email address from which the statement is sent may have been identified as junk / spam by your email server. Gmail users please refer to Primary/Update/Promotion/ Social tab in your mail box.
Also, please check if the email id provided by you is correct on our records. You can do so by logging onto sbicard.com ‘Your Profile' section and clicking on “Quick Contacts” on the left menu to check the email ID registered with us. If there is a change in your email ID, we request you to update it online. You can View / Print / Download your Statements for the last 24 months or from the date of registration, whichever is recent.
  * ## Q6. What is a billing date/cycle and due date? Can it be changed?
  * Billing date/cycle is the date on which the statement is generated for your credit card every month. Generate OTP Enter the OTP received on old registered number & click on ‘Submit’ You will receive a call from SBI Card Representative within 2 working days to process your request.

Would request you to send the scanned documents via E-mail at contactchange@sbicard.com
SBI Card Payment & Services Ltd, P.O. Bag No 1, DLF Qutab Enclave PO Gurgaon – 122002 (Haryana)

Submit your request along with relevant KYC document(s) and duly signed request letter mentioning your 16-digit SBI Credit Card number or account number. To find your nearest SBI Card Walk-In service desks, refer the list enclosed.
Please note that, in case of physical documents received through Walk-In desks, at least one of the documents should be self-attested.

  * The charges applicable on this service are based on the rules and regulations of your bank. There are no uniform charges that are applied for VMT transactions, universally.

  * ## Q8. Can I use a credit card to transfer funds through Visa Credit Card Pay?
  * You can only use bank accounts to transfer funds using Visa Credit Card Pay.

# If you have received a communication viz letter / email or SMS mentioning that your account has been transferred, these FAQs should be able to help you resolve any queries that you may have
  * A credit card account is deemed to have been transferred when the account, along with the card outstanding dues under the Primary Credit Card and Add-on Card(s), if any, is transferred / assigned by SBI Card to a third party / assignee.
  * The customer’s obligation to pay SBI Card, all outstanding amounts with respect to his / her Credit Card account, is transferred to a third party, who can initiate all measures applicable under the law for recovery of amounts outstanding under the transferred credit card account.
  * ## Q3. Why was my account transferred? / How can you transfer my account to a third party without my consent?
  * Account transfer / assignment is permissible as per applicable laws and communication in this regard has already been sent to your mailing address / registered e-mail ID as available in our records
  * ## Q4. Why am I getting collection calls from a third party? / I don’t owe anything, why am I getting calls?
  * There is an outstanding on your SBI Credit Card account and your account has been transferred / assigned to a third party and they would be following up for such credit card dues henceforth. For any information in this regard, you can contact the third party using the contact details shared with you in the E-mail / Letter communication sent to you to inform you about the transfer.
  * ## Q5. Will SBI Card stop reporting my trade in bureau now?
  * Yes, SBI Card will stop reporting and updating the status of your credit card account. Further, your account status has been reported as ‘Account Sold’ in bureau records. Henceforth, the third party, to whom your credit card account has been transferred / assigned, will report the account status of your account to Bureau.
  * ## Q6. I want to settle my account / pay in instalments. Please advise. / I do not want to transfer my account. Can I raise a request for the same?
  * We would request you to get in touch with the third party, to whom your account has been transferred / assigned, for further queries pertaining to this account. you can contact the third party using the contact details shared with you in the E-mail / Letter communication sent to you to inform you about the transfer.
  * ## Q7. I have some specific queries related to my credit card account, e.g. last transaction details, NOC, Previous statements, etc. Who should I contact?
  * For any kind of query pertaining to your account, we would request you to get in touch with the third party to whom your account has been transferred / assigned. you can contact the third party using the contact details shared with you in the E-mail / Letter communication sent to you to inform you about the transfer.
  * Your SBI Credit Card account has been transferred, along with the card outstanding dues under the Primary Credit Card and Add-on Card(s), if any, and hence your online login ID has be deactivated. For further queries pertaining to your account, you can contact the third party using the contact details shared with you in the E-mail / Letter communication sent to you to inform you about the transfer.
  * ## Q9. What is the impact of this transfer on my ability to take new credit cards/loans? Can I apply for a fresh SBI Credit Card?
  * Transfer of Account will have no additional impact on your ability to take new credit cards / loans or a fresh SBI Credit Card.

* ## Q1. How can I update my international travel details with SBI Card?
  * You can log in to www.sbicard.com and update your travel plan details using OTP authentication.
  * ## Q2. I do not remember my SBI Card online account user ID and password. How can I access the website?
  * Step 2: Click ‘Forgot My Login Details’ and enter your credit card number, CVV and date of birth and click on ‘Proceed’. You will now receive a one-time password (OTP) on your Registered Mobile Number.
Step 3: : Enter the OTP in the space provided and click on ‘Proceed’ again.
Step 4: You will now be redirected to change password page. Set your new password and continue to log on to the SBI Card website with your new credentials.
  * ## Q3. Which option do I select to enter my international travel details?
  * Post website log in, enter user ID and password. Select ‘Update Travel Plan’ from Services Tab.
  * ## Q4. I have two credit cards with SBI Card. Can I update travel details for both of my cards?
  * Yes, you can update travel details for more than one card. In each request, you can update travel details for up to 2 primary cards.
  * ## Q5. Next month I am travelling abroad. Can I update my travel details now?
  * Yes, you can only add a future planned travel journey, in advance up to 15 days from the present date.
  * ## Q6. Can I update my international number on the website?
  * Yes, you can update or edit your international number to continue receiving transaction alert and One-Time Password (OTP) when you are travelling abroad.
  * ## Q7. Can I change my transaction preference for international transaction on the SBI Card website?
  * Yes, you can also manage these switches from the ‘Manage Card Usage’ section at any point of time.

pages.markdown:
* ## Q1. How can I switch on/off and set/modify limits for different category of transactions (for domestic and international usage) on the SBI Card app/website?
  * Please follow any of the below mentioned process to activate or set/modify the usage/limits for different transaction categories on your SBI Credit Card:
    * - Login => Select ‘Manage Card Usage’ => Select ‘Manage Card Transactions’ => Choose Transaction category / limit to be modified
    * - Login => Go to ‘Menu’ and select ‘Manage Card Usage’ => Click on ‘Manage Card Transactions’ => Choose Transaction category / limit to be modified
    * Click to visit Chatbot ILA or click on ILA icon available on the SBI Card website and follow the below steps -
      * Choose the transaction usage category (Domestic/ International) to be activated basis your requirement
      * Activate the transaction type (e.g., Domestic Online, etc.) & set the transaction limit
      * Authenticate the request using the OTP shared on your Registered Mobile Number
  * ## Q2. I am the secondary/add-on cardholder. Can I change the transaction usages/limits on the SBI Card App/website?
  * No. Transaction limits on the SBI Card account can only be managed by a Primary account holder for both primary and add-on Card
  * ## Q3. Will there be a lag if I activate/deactivate/change limit for any transaction usage for any category?
  * ## Q4. What will happen if I do a transaction(eg. Online) and my domestic online transaction category switch is OFF?
  * The said transaction will get declined. Similar behavior will be applicable for all transaction types(for domestic and international usage). To successfully complete the transaction, please switch ON the corresponding transaction category switch(Domestic Online in this case). To manage transaction category usage, please check Question 1.
  * ## Q5. What will happen if I do a transaction(domestic/international) greater than the transaction category limit set but lesser than my credit limit?
  * The said transaction will get declined. To successfully complete the transaction, please increase the corresponding category limit OR attempt a transaction within the transaction category limit set. To manage transaction category limits, please check Question 1.
  * Transactions done in India in currency code as INR (Indian Rupees). Kindly enable your domestic usage to transact at retails stores or online websites/ mobile apps in India.
  * Transactions done in foreign currency or INR in countries outside India(Except Nepal and Bhutan). Kindly enable your international usage to transact online on international websites/ at stores outside of India.
  * Online transactions include payment done on a website, mobile app/QR Code or any other online mode(including auto-debit/standing instructions etc.), for the purchase of goods or services.
  * Point of Sale(POS) transaction is a payment done at retail store using point of sale (POS) terminals by dipping your credit card/payment using card tokenization services (eg. Samsung Pay/SBI Card Pay). Activate your credit card for making POS transactions.
  * Contactless/Tap & Pay transactions are done by tapping your card at NFC (Near Field Communication) enabled Point of Sale (PoS) terminals for purchase of goods or services.
  * Automated Teller Machine(ATM) transaction is a transaction done at ATMs to avail cash/use other ATM facility.
  * Using ‘Set Your Spend Limits ‘ link you can set your individual category usage as per billing cycle credit limit.
  * ## Q13. What is the max. limit that I can set for any category?
  * The maximum limit for any category can be set equivalent to the credit limit on the card. In case of ATM transactions, the maximum limit that can be set will be the cash limit on the card.
  * ## Q14. What happens to my existing Standing Instructions/Autopay bill registrations done through SBI Credit Card website/mobile app ?
  * These transactions are treated as online domestic transactions. Please ensure that your online switch is ON for domestic transactions
  * ## Q15. What happens to any Standing Instructions that I had set directly at merchant websites/app?
  * These transactions are treated as online transactions. Please ensure that your online switch is ON for domestic & International transactions
  * ## Q16. Why are all these transaction categories listed on the app/website?
  * The different transaction usage categories have been added for enhanced security on your card.

Faced an issue with your SBI Credit Card transaction? Bring it to our notice by raising a ticket on the SBI Credit Card website and receive quick support.
Be a smart SBI Card user and make the best of your card
Credit cards come with legal contracts. Hence, it is important that you are aware of their terms and conditions, when you sign up for them.
Please read your credit card application carefully to know about your card’s features and associated Terms and Conditions. The information mentioned in small prints may have big impacts on your fee, charges and usage conditions. While some T&Cs are similar on all cards, there are many others that may be particular to the ones you are applying for, so we recommend that you go through all of them.
If your card has multiple users, know about the liabilities shared by secondary users. Also, if you have applied for , understand the added responsibilities that come with them such as who will manage the cards, pay bills and debts, etc.
Knowing how to cancel your card is as important as knowing how to use it. When you decide to close a Credit Card, make sure all payments have been made and there are no pending dues. Avoid closing cards that still have outstanding balance to be cleared or those that make a significant amount of your credit history. Cancelling such cards impact your credit score.
Credit Cards give you the freedom of taking cash advances. But avail this service only at the time of emergency because cash advances are levied with charges, which you start paying from the day you have taken the advance. There is no grace period on cash advances from a credit card.
In case of unexpected expenses, it is better to talk to your credit card company and explore different options that you can take advantage of, such as availing low interest credit options. This way you can save on the amount you repay.
Credit cards give you a lot of power and if you follow some crucial mantras about their usage, you can harness them well.
Ensure the safety of your Credit Card, PIN number, Card expiry date, CVV(security code) by all means. Also, Please do not share your One Time Password(OTP) with anyone. Always get your current contact number updated to ensure receipt of transaction alerts. Whenever you travel abroad, please stay informed about the benefits you can avail in case of card loss or theft, such & Emergency Card replacement services.
Be vigilant and check your credit card statements/transaction alert SMS carefully for any suspicious transaction(s). If you ever notice any unsolicited transaction, immediately report the same.
Avail from institutions that follow national & international standards for secure transactions
Do not hand-over your credit card to people, whom you do not know. When you shop, make sure that the card is not out of your sight and you have collected your card at the end of the transaction. Also, before signing the charge slip, check the amount printed on it.
Keep your Credit Card, CVV and helpline numbers saved with you separately and in case of card loss or theft, immediately inform your card issuer and get the card blocked.
Always log in into your credit card account from a secure computer that is malware free. Make a strong password(combination of Upper case, numbers & special characters) for the online account of your credit card and do not share your password with anyone.
Refrain from responding to correspondences that asks for your Credit Card number, expiry date, CVV or password/OTP details. Banks or your card issuer, will never ask for this information from you. Whenever you get such mails, calls, SMS, etc. bring them to the notice of your card issuer.
Click for a detailed account on dos and don’ts related to the safety of your credit cards.
Credit Score is a 3-digit number, which represents your credit history based on your credit behavior. The Credit score ranges between 300 - 900. High score implies a good credit history. A score below 600 is poor, whereas ideally score greater than 750 is the best.
As per RBI guidelines, SBI Card regularly submits credit information of all cardholders to respective bureaus on a regular basis. Some major bureaus include:
When you apply for a loan or credit card, the lending/issuing company checks your credit score first to determine if you are eligible to avail the loan or get a credit card.
Higher is the score better are your application approval chance. Low score places you in a Risk Zone and makes it difficult to secure an approval.
  1. Ensure timely payments of your monthly credit card dues to maintain good credit history and high score.
  2. Usage of credit card balance above credit limit affect credit score negatively.
  3. Making partial payments of your monthly credit dues/outstanding bills.

Click here for a detailed account on dos and don’ts related to the safety of your credit cards.
As per the Know Your Customer guidelines of the Reserve Bank of India, we need to periodically update customer details and obtain identification documents. You are requested to submit the required KYC documents for your Credit Card and for Add-on Cards (if any) at the earliest either of the following ways mentioned below:
A) Login to your SBI Credit Card account and submit your KYC document(s) through DigiLocker along with the self-declaration of your current residence address. Follow these simple steps:

B) Manually upload your KYC document(s) along with a recent passport size photograph at https://www.sbicard.com/kycupload. Please refer to the below mentioned list of Officially Valid Documents and submit one of them:
  1. Copy of masked Aadhaar / Virtual ID card (both sides mask first 8-digits of Aadhaar Number).^
  2. Voter ID Card issued by the Election Commission of India (both sides)
  3. Job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the State Government
  4. Letter issued by the National Population Register containing details of name and address

^ For seamless processing please visit to download your e-Aadhaar having the mandatory secure QR code for validation. Note, the file should not be password protected. So, take a clear photo of the e-Aadhaar copy and upload the same.
In case the documents submitted by a foreign national does not contain the details of address, the documents issued by the Govt departments of foreign jurisdictions and letter issued by the Foreign Embassy or Mission in India shall be accepted as proof of address.
For NRI (Non-Resident Indians) /PIO (Person of Indian Origin) /OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders, any of the following documents can be submitted as current address proof as applicable:

In case of NRI/PIO/Foreign National as defined in Foreign Exchange Management (Deposit) Regulations, 2016 alternatively, the original certified copy of documents with Passport (both sides), certified by any one of the following, may be obtained:
    1. Authorized officials of overseas branches of Scheduled Commercial Banks registered in India,
    2. Branches of overseas banks with whom Indian banks have relationships,
    3. Indian Embassy/Consulate General in the country where the non-resident customer resides.

*Refer to the RBI circular below:RBI/DBR/2015-16/18 Master Direction DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (as updated from time to time)
* For Driving Licenses issued in states where it is specifically mentioned that the document cannot be used as address proof the same will not be acceptable as an address proof KYC document.
• Documents should be valid on current date• In case your name in KYC document does not match with SBI Card records, we shall update your name in our records as per the KYC documents provided by you • As per the notification, in case of any change in the KYC details submitted with SBI Card at the time of onboarding or periodic update, please share the updated documents within 30 days of any such change.
If, in case your current residence address is not updated in any of your Officially Valid Documents to be submitted as proof, you can still submit the address change requests as per below:
Submit your KYC document through Digilocker along with self-declaration of your current residence address. Login to our website http://sbicard.com and go to ‘Menu’, click on ‘My Accounts’ and click on ‘KYC Renewal’ to submit your request.
Alternatively, if you want to update your current resident address in your Officially Valid Document, the same can be done using the following options:
• Visit to check the required documents and get your address updated online in UID• Register on Visit and select option ‘migration to other place’.• Visit your nearest Passport Seva Kendra.• Visit your respective RTO office.

* WhatsApp Connect is SBI Card’s WhatsApp service, through which Customers can get important updates regarding their SBI Card account on WhatsApp, provided they have subscribed to WhatsApp Connect.
  * ## Q 2. I want to opt-in for Whatsapp”, How can customer subscribe for SBI Card’s WhatsApp Connect?
  * Customer can subscribe to SBI Card’s WhatsApp service by following any of the below ways:
    * Give a missed call at 08080945040 from your registered mobile number
    * SBI Card Mobile App: Login to Mobile App, go to the main menu and select ‘WhatsApp Connect’ to subscribe to our WhatsApp service.
    * SBI Card Website: Click here, to login and subscribe our WhatsApp service.
    * Ask ILA: Click here, to login and subscribe our WhatsApp service.
    * SMS: SMS WAOPTIN XXXX to 5676791, where XXXX is the last 4 digits of your card number.
  * ## Q 3. From which number will a customer receive alerts on WhatsApp?
  * Customer will receive alert on WhatsApp through the number - 9004022022
  * ## Q 4. How can a customer opt-out from WhatsApp Service?
  * Customer can opt-out by following any of the below steps:
    * SMS: SMS WAOPTOUT XXXX to 5676791, where XXXX is the last 4 digits of your card number.
  * ## Q 5. Can one subscribe for SBI Card’s WhatsApp Service, even if he/she is not an SBI credit Cardholder?
  * Presently, SBI Card’s WhatsApp service is only available for SBI Credit Cardholders
  * ## Q 6. If one unsubscribes from SBI Card’s WhatsApp Service, can he/she subscribe again?
  * Yes, one can subscribe again to the WhatsApp Service by initiating an opt-in request
  * ## Q 7. Are there any charges for the WhatsApp Service?

Using a credit card online is convenient, but staying alert is essential. With cybercrime on the rise, protecting your card details is key to avoiding financial loss. SBI Credit Cards come with advanced security features such as tokenisation, two-factor authentication, and secured payment gateways to ensure safe and secure transactions. Here are a few credit card security tips that will help you keep your confidential information safe from the hands of hackers and fraudsters.
  1. When receiving your SBI Credit Card, make sure the welcome kit is sealed. If not, call the SBI Card Helpline Number immediately.
  2. Protect your credit card's confidential details like PIN, Card Expiry Date, and Card Verification Value (CVV). Never share them with anyone through phone call or E-mail.
  3. Choose credible websites and apps when paying with your credit card. Secure websites begin with HTTPS and HTTP. Watch out for dubious websites by checking for misspellings and ‘not secure’ warnings.
  4. Always download SBI Card Mobile App from Play Store and App Store. Never click on any APK links shared via SMS / E-mails / WhatsApp.
  5. Do not swipe your credit card in an ATM or POS machine that looks tampered with.
  6. Do not click on suspicious links in E-mails and text messages.
  7. Enable real-time SMS and E-mail transaction alerts to keep yourself updated. Always get your current contact number updated to avoid missing alerts.
  8. If you lose your credit card, immediately report the loss and block it by calling the customer support team. In such times, keeping your Credit Card Number, CVV and Helpline Numbers saved with you separately comes in handy.
  9. Stay informed about the credit card benefits available in the event of card loss or theft during international travel, such as card insurance plans and emergency card replacement services.
  10. Be vigilant and check your credit card statements or transaction alert SMS carefully for any suspicious transactions. If you ever notice any unsolicited transactions, immediately report them.

Your credit card approval depends on the specific eligibility requirements that you meet. Once you apply for an SBI Credit Card, your eligibility is assessed based on multiple parameters such as your age, income, employment status, credit score, past credit card ownership and credit history. It is important to note that these basic criteria may differ depending on the type of credit card you choose. It is always wise to verify specific details on the particular card section.
  1. Banking Relationship - Not mandatory, but may improve approval chances
  2. Credit Score - Good credit score, preferably between 750 and 900

Understanding credit card interest rate is essential, whether you are a new credit card user or an existing one. Credit card interest rate is also known as credit card finance charges. Interest is levied when you make partial or no payment of your credit card bill on or before its due date. Interest rate is typically stated as 'yearly' rate, also known as the Annual Percentage Rate (APR). SBI Card charges a standard and fixed interest rate of up to 45% per annum (3.75% per month).
  1. **When you skip paying the credit card bill by the Payment Due Date -** If you don't pay your credit card bill altogether, you will be charged interest on the outstanding amount as well as on any new transactions you make after the due date, till the previous balance is cleared. In addition, a Late Payment Fee will be applied to your account.
  2. If you don't pay your full credit card bill instead pay only the Minimum Due Amount, the interest will be charged on the remaining balance and also on all the new transactions made until the previous amount is paid in full.
  3. **When you pay less than the Minimum Amount Due -** Paying the Minimum Amount Due is mandatory. If you pay less than the Minimum Amount Due on your credit card, the interest will be charged on the full amount and not just the balance, along with any new purchases made until the previous amount is paid in full.

If you use your credit card wisely, you can enjoy interest-free credit, many rewards and freedom from cash. It offers convenience, security and the ability to build a credit history. But credit cards also come with legal contracts.
Hence, it is important that you are aware of their terms and conditions when you sign up for them to avail maximum benefits.
  1. Read your credit card application carefully to know about your card's features and associated Terms and Conditions. The information mentioned in small print may have big impact on your fee, charges and usage conditions. While some T&Cs are common across cards, many others are specific to the card you are applying for, so it's important to review them carefully.
  2. If your card has multiple users, understand the liabilities shared by secondary users. Also, if you have applied for add-on cards, understand the added responsibilities that come with them such as who will manage the cards, pay bills and debts, etc.
  3. Knowing how to close your card is as important as knowing how to use it. When you decide to close a credit card, ensure all the payments have been made and there are no pending dues. Avoid closing cards that form a significant part of your credit history, as cancelling them can negatively impact your credit score.
  4. Credit cards allow you to withdraw cash, but this facility should be used only in emergencies. Cash advances attract high charges and interest starts accruing from the very day you withdraw the money, as there is no interest-free grace period on cash advances.
  5. In case of unexpected expenses, it is better to talk to your credit card company and explore different options that you can take advantage of, such as availing low-interest credit options. This way, you can save on the amount you repay.

When you apply for a credit card, the issuing company first checks your credit score to determine your eligibility for a credit card. It is a three-digit number ranging between 300 and 900 and it indicates your creditworthiness based on your financial behavior and payment history. A higher score of 750 or above is generally considered good and reflects your strong financial credibility, thereby increasing your chances of application approval. Whereas a low score below 600 is considered poor and places you in a risk zone, making it difficult to secure an approval. Having said that, people with lower scores can also be eligible for a credit card. Since the risk is higher for individuals with lower scores, interest rates tend to be higher and credit limits are often lower compared to those with a strong credit score.
  1. Irregular Payments - Non-payment or irregular payments of your monthly credit card dues can negatively affect your credit score.
  2. Partial Payments - Making partial payments of your monthly credit cards/ outstanding bills can negatively affect your credit score.
  3. Over-Utilization of your Credit limit - Usage of credit card balance above credit limit affects your credit score negatively.
  4. Applying for too many credit cards - Too many credit card applications within a short time may give the issuing company the impression that you are desperate for credit. This can hurt your credit score.

Using a credit card online is convenient, but staying alert is essential. With cybercrime on the rise, protecting your card details is key to avoiding financial loss. SBI Credit Cards come with advanced security features such as tokenisation, two-factor authentication, and secured payment gateways to ensure safe and secure transactions. Here are a few credit card security tips that will help you keep your confidential information safe from the hands of hackers and fraudsters.
  1. When receiving your SBI Credit Card, make sure the welcome kit is sealed. If not, call the SBI Card Helpline Number immediately.
  2. Protect your credit card's confidential details like PIN, Card Expiry Date, and Card Verification Value (CVV). Never share them with anyone through phone call or E-mail.
  3. Choose credible websites and apps when paying with your credit card. Secure websites begin with HTTPS and HTTP. Watch out for dubious websites by checking for misspellings and ‘not secure’ warnings.
  4. Always download SBI Card Mobile App from Play Store and App Store. Never click on any APK links shared via SMS / E-mails / WhatsApp.
  5. Do not swipe your credit card in an ATM or POS machine that looks tampered with.
  6. Do not click on suspicious links in E-mails and text messages.
  7. Enable real-time SMS and E-mail transaction alerts to keep yourself updated. Always get your current contact number updated to avoid missing alerts.
  8. If you lose your credit card, immediately report the loss and block it by calling the customer support team. In such times, keeping your Credit Card Number, CVV and Helpline Numbers saved with you separately comes in handy.
  9. Stay informed about the credit card benefits available in the event of card loss or theft during international travel, such as card insurance plans and emergency card replacement services.
  10. Be vigilant and check your credit card statements or transaction alert SMS carefully for any suspicious transactions. If you ever notice any unsolicited transactions, immediately report them.

Your credit card approval depends on the specific eligibility requirements that you meet. Once you apply for an SBI Credit Card, your eligibility is assessed based on multiple parameters such as your age, income, employment status, credit score, past credit card ownership and credit history. It is important to note that these basic criteria may differ depending on the type of credit card you choose. It is always wise to verify specific details on the particular card section.
  1. Banking Relationship - Not mandatory, but may improve approval chances
  2. Credit Score - Good credit score, preferably between 750 and 900

Understanding credit card interest rate is essential, whether you are a new credit card user or an existing one. Credit card interest rate is also known as credit card finance charges. Interest is levied when you make partial or no payment of your credit card bill on or before its due date. Interest rate is typically stated as 'yearly' rate, also known as the Annual Percentage Rate (APR). SBI Card charges a standard and fixed interest rate of up to 45% per annum (3.75% per month).
  1. **When you skip paying the credit card bill by the Payment Due Date -** If you don't pay your credit card bill altogether, you will be charged interest on the outstanding amount as well as on any new transactions you make after the due date, till the previous balance is cleared. In addition, a Late Payment Fee will be applied to your account.
  2. If you don't pay your full credit card bill instead pay only the Minimum Due Amount, the interest will be charged on the remaining balance and also on all the new transactions made until the previous amount is paid in full.
  3. **When you pay less than the Minimum Amount Due -** Paying the Minimum Amount Due is mandatory. If you pay less than the Minimum Amount Due on your credit card, the interest will be charged on the full amount and not just the balance, along with any new purchases made until the previous amount is paid in full.

If you use your credit card wisely, you can enjoy interest-free credit, many rewards and freedom from cash. It offers convenience, security and the ability to build a credit history. But credit cards also come with legal contracts.
Hence, it is important that you are aware of their terms and conditions when you sign up for them to avail maximum benefits.
  1. Read your credit card application carefully to know about your card's features and associated Terms and Conditions. The information mentioned in small print may have big impact on your fee, charges and usage conditions. While some T&Cs are common across cards, many others are specific to the card you are applying for, so it's important to review them carefully.
  2. If your card has multiple users, understand the liabilities shared by secondary users. Also, if you have applied for add-on cards, understand the added responsibilities that come with them such as who will manage the cards, pay bills and debts, etc.
  3. Knowing how to close your card is as important as knowing how to use it. When you decide to close a credit card, ensure all the payments have been made and there are no pending dues. Avoid closing cards that form a significant part of your credit history, as cancelling them can negatively impact your credit score.
  4. Credit cards allow you to withdraw cash, but this facility should be used only in emergencies. Cash advances attract high charges and interest starts accruing from the very day you withdraw the money, as there is no interest-free grace period on cash advances.
  5. In case of unexpected expenses, it is better to talk to your credit card company and explore different options that you can take advantage of, such as availing low-interest credit options. This way, you can save on the amount you repay.

pages.markdown:
Introducing ‘SBI Card Pay’ that allows you to make payments simply with your smartphone. You don’t have to carry your SBI Credit Card anymore, just tap your android smartphone on NFC enabled POS machine to make faster & secure payments of up to Rs. 5000.
Make easy payments with just a tap of your android smartphone
The Credit Card details are never shared with the merchant
### **Q1. What all do I need to do for making a payment using SBI Card Pay feature in the SBI Card Mobile App?**
You would need the following to make a payment using SBI Card Pay feature:

### **Q2. How does a payment happen with the SBI Card Pay feature?**
SBI Card Pay uses the NFC technology to make a contactless payment that is carried out by using a smartphone at NFC enabled Point of Sale (POS) machines. You can transact up to Rs. 25,000 in a day (max. capping of up to Rs. 5,000 per transaction). For transactions above Rs. 5000, card PIN needs to be entered for completing the payment.
Near Field Communication or NFC is a method of wirelessly transmitting data using radio waves. Tap to Pay uses NFC to wirelessly transmit payment data to payment terminals with NFC readers that have been activated for use. The payment information is transmitted in an encrypted format making the transaction completely secure.
### **Q4. How can I register my SBI Credit Card to pay using the SBI Card Pay feature?**
You can follow the below steps toon the SBI Card Pay feature:
  * Download the latest version of the SBI Card App from Playstore
  * Log into SBI Card App and click on the ‘SBI Card Pay’ icon present at the bottom of screen
  * Select the SBI Card that you wish to register, agree to the SBI Card Terms & Conditions and click on the ‘Link Card’ button

On successful registration, you will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number.
### **Q5. How can I make payments using SBI Card Pay?**
You can follow the below steps to pay using the SBI Card Pay feature:
  * Click on the ‘SBI Card Pay’ icon on the pre-login page or on the account summary page that appears after you have logged into your account
  * Select the SBI Card with which you want to pay & click on the ‘PAY’ button
  * On successful payment, you will receive a payment confirmation SMS on your registered mobile number

You can also make payments without opening the SBI Card App. Just unlock the mobile device and tap on the NFC enabled merchant’s POS machine to make the payment.
### **Q6. How can I de-link my SBI Card from the SBI Card Pay feature?**
You can follow the below steps to de-link your SBI Card from the SBI Card Pay feature:
  * Click on the App Settings and click on the ‘SBI Card Pay’ button

You will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number on successful de-linking of yourfrom the Tap to Pay feature.

  *   * ### Get New Card - Amazon Voucher offer for customers availing new pre-approved additional card (valid from 20 Dec 2025 to 31 Dec 2025)
**Exclusive offer for customers availing New additional SBI Credit Card - Terms & Conditions :-**
    * The Terms and Conditions for this offer are to be read in conjunction with the Terms and Conditions for “Get New Card” available at
    * This offer is open exclusively to select cardholders of SBICPSL who have been issued a new additional SBI Credit Card (hereinafter referred to as New Additional Card) in response to the offer rolled out to such select cardholders and communicated via SMS/E-mail
    * Cardholders are not bound in any way to participate in the offer. Any such participation is voluntary and the same is being made available purely on a 'best effort basis'.
    * This offer will be valid only for select customers who are onboarded with a New Additional Card with effect from <>subject to their receiving a specific offer related communication via SMS/E-mail or Whatsapp.
    * This is a limited period offer and will be valid for New Additional Card issued until 31st Dec, 2025 or till the date as mentioned in the offer communication sent to the cardholder via SMS/E-mail or Whatsapp.
    * Under the offer, the Cardholder shall be eligible for an Amazon Pay Gift Card worth INR 250 upon successful issuance of a new card against the communication received.
    * The offer shall be fulfilled within 60 days of receipt of payment of the card annual fee of the New Additional Card.
    * The mode of fulfilment will be SMS/E-mail and the cardholder shall be communicated at his/her Registered Mobile Number and E-mail ID.
    * It will be the cardholder’s responsibility to ensure that the latest and valid mobile number and E-mail ID are updated in the records of SBICPSL to enable fulfilment of the offer.
    * In case of any query regarding offer fulfilment, please contact SBI Card Helpline (18601801290 / 39020202- prefix local STD Code) within 60 days from the date of fulfillment. No queries regarding offer fulfillment will be entertained by SBICPSL post this period.
    * The usage of the Amazon Pay Gift Card code shall be governed by the Terms & Conditions as laid down by Amazon in the succeeding sections.
    * Offering the above benefits to customers in exception to the qualifying criteria will be at the sole discretion of SBICPSL
    * SBICPSL reserves the right to cancel, modify or withdraw the offer & alter offer terms & conditions as its sole discretion without prior notice. SBICPSL reserves the right to being the final decision maker regarding the offer.
    * SBICPSL neither endorses, nor recommends the quality, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose(s), after sale services, warranties etc., of the products and/or services being made available under this offer.

Any disputes arising out of these T&C’s shall be subject to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed by SBICPSL for this purpose. The proceedings of the arbitration shall be conducted as per the provisions of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The venue & seat of arbitration shall be at New Delhi and language of arbitration shall be English.
    * These Terms and Conditions are to be read in conjunction with the T&Cs for “Exclusive offer for customers availing New Additional SBI Credit Card” as mentioned above.
    * These terms and conditions apply to Amazon Pay Gift Cards (Gift Cards) issued by Pine Labs Private Limited (Pine Labs) under the Brand Name of Qwikcilver and co-branded with Amazon Pay (India) Private Limited (Amazon Pay). Pine Labs is a private limited company organized under the laws of India and is the issuer of the Gift Cards. You may purchase Gift Cards through various options available on www.amazon.in corresponding mobile site and mobile application ("Amazon.in"), and also use Gift Cards provided to you by third parties in the manner provided hereunder. By purchasing or using a Gift Card, you are agreeing to and accept these terms and conditions.
    * A customer can add a maximum of INR 50,000 of Amazon Pay Gift cards in a calendar month.
    * The Add Gift Card to balance limit includes purchases from all sources.
    * Amazon reserves the right to modify this (Add Gift Card to balance) limit at any point of time.
    * ‘Add Gift Card to balance Limit’ resets at the beginning of each calendar month; a customer can resume adding Gift Card after this reset.
    * Amazon reserves the right to offer exceptions to the monthly claim limit based on specific corporate use cases.
    * For any queries related to GV / GC, raise a request at.
    * To redeem your GC, visit. For complete Terms and Conditions, visit www.amazon.in/giftcardtnc.
    * SBICPSL may engage, hire, use the services of agent(s) and/or any third party(ies) for the purpose of providing marketing or sales related services or any other related services in relation to its products on its behalf and the customer may be required to deal with such agents/third parties/service providers with respect to such product/services.
    * In case of any dispute relating to these terms and conditions, the decision of SBICPSL shall be final and binding.
    * SBICPSL reserves the right to modify or change any of these terms and conditions at its sole discretion without prior notice.
    * These terms & conditions shall be governed and interpreted as per the laws of India and any dispute relating to these terms & conditions shall be subjected to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Delhi.
    * I and the additional cardholder(s) agree unconditionally to be bound by the terms and conditions of the cardholder agreement accompanying each SBI Credit Card.
    * I accept the fee structure mentioned under the Most Important Terms and Conditions placed at. I understand that the Annual fee shall be required to be paid by me on receiving the first statement of account, if applicable. I further understand that starting from the second year, renewal fee, if applicable, will be paid by me every year and shall be billed to me in the statement of account.

I confirm that I have been duly communicated and I have fully understood all accompanying terms and conditions of SBI Credit Card.
    * I acknowledge that in case auto-debit is enabled on my existing (old) SBI Credit Card, the same will not be automatically enabled on the new SBI Credit Card availed through this process.
    * In all events of payments not being paid by the due date, SBICPSL reserves the right to carry out follow ups by means of personal visits, post, fax, telephone, E-mail, SMS and/or engaging third party to remind, follow-up and collect due payments in any manner deemed fit by SBICPSL keeping the intent in view.]

I hereby confirm that I would be the beneficial owner of the SBI Credit Card as understood in the normal business parlance and in accordance with existing regulations. I hereby undertake to comply with all directives from SBICPSL in my capacity as the beneficial owner of the SBI Credit Card, if and when such credit card is issued by SBICPSL to me based upon approval of my SBI Credit Card application.
    * I have read and understood all SBICPSL policies regarding data privacy and security procedures published on its web site www.sbicard.com and acknowledge all its content.

  *   *   * ### Exclusive offer for cardholders of SBI Card PRIME American Express® Card
#### Get an Amazon e-gift voucher worth Rs. 1000 on total spend of Rs. 10,000 in 60 days from card issuance
    * This Offer ('Offer') from SBI Cards & Payment Services Ltd. (formerly known as SBI Cards and Payment Services Private Limited) (hereinafter referred to as 'SBICPSL') is open to SELECT cardholders holding a valid and current SBI Card ELITE American Express® Card (hereinafter SBI Card ELITE) with no outstanding of more than 30 days , excluding corporate card ('Cardholder').
    * The Offer is applicable on customers who comply or fulfill criterion as determined by SBICPSL.
    * Under this offer, to be eligible for the complimentary gift/product, the cardholder needs to spend and/or do asked number of transactions within the offer period ('Term') in accordance with the instructions/specifications provided in the communication sent through SMS/Email by SBICPSL. All the cumulative purchases within the offer period may also be clubbed together to avail this offer.
    * If the offer is based on online transactions and/or spends, customers who do any ONLINE credit card transactions like travel booking, bill payments, movie ticketing or any other online transactions will qualify for the offer subject to spending to target amount as communicated in the emailer and/or SMS. All the cumulative online purchases within the offer period may also be clubbed together to avail the offer.
    * Any qualifying transaction does not include spends on Fuel, ATM Cash Withdrawal, Balance Transfer, Balance Transfer on EMI, Encash and Easy Money draft products of SBICPSL.
    * Returned purchases/reversals (for all transactions done during or before the offer period), disputed and/or unauthorized/fraudulent transactions, EMI's and fees/charges will not be considered for this offer.
    * Eligible cardholders for an E-gift Voucher, will be communicated via email/SMS..
    * OTP and other communications will happen on registered mobile number and/or email id only.
    * Cardholder to ensure that the registered mobile is not on DNCR (Do no call registration) list to receive the e-code for redeeming the gift.
    * Kindly check your mobile DNCR status on www.ndnc.com. If you wish to Deactivate DNCR i.e start getting promotional offer SMS/calls, send an SMS with the message START 1 to 1909.
    * SBICPSL reserves the right to revise/change/modify/discard offers and target construct at any point during the campaign period.
    * Cardholder to ensure and update latest mobile number and e-mail ID to receive periodic communication related to this offer. In case, the eligible cardholder does not have a valid registered mobile number and/or email address with SBICPSL, the E-gift Voucher code to redeem the gift will not be communicated.
    * All SBI Card PRIME accounts opened upto and including 31st May 2021 shall be eligible for this offer.
    * Cardholder needs to achieve INR 10,000 spends within 60 days from the date of account opening to be eligible for an Amazon e-gift voucher worth INR 1000.
    * Spends on multiple primary cards cannot be clubbed by the Cardholder for the said offer.
    * Spends made on add-on cards for particular primary card shall also be considered under this offer and shall be counted towards the total spends made on the card account.
    * Eligible cardholders will be communicated a voucher code through SMS and/or email to registered mobile number and/or email address updated with SBICPSL within 60 days of offer end date.
    * E-gift Vouchers can be used only once within the validity period.
    * Cardholder to ensure that the redemption of gift is done before expiry. Extension of codes will not be granted under any circumstance.
    * All physical gifts can be shipped only within the delivery area of vendor, and customer must provide a valid address and pincode within the delivery area. SBICPSL shall in no way be liable if customer is unable to place an order for delivery within the delivery area.
    * SBICPSL will not be responsible for email bounces, non-delivery of SMSs, wrong email id/mobile number updation or incomplete email id/mobile number updation in the system etc. Email/SMS will be sent to the email id and mobile number as updated in SBICPSL's system.
    * SBICPSL will not be responsible for non-delivery of E-gift Voucher code to redeem gift in case the mobile number is on DNCR as per regulation.

    * The products & services offered under this offer are at the sole responsibility of the participating Merchants and at their exclusive costs and consequences. SBICPSL does not endorse, nor recommends the quality, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose(s), after sale services, warranties etc., of the products and/or services being made available under this offer.

    * All government Levies like Sales Tax, TDS, any Local Tax, Octroi etc., shall be payable by the Cardholder as applicable at the time the respective Programs were offered.
    * Any person availing this offer shall be deemed to have accepted these Terms and Conditions
    * Any query regarding the Offer or any matter related thereof will be entertained only till 60 days post offer end date. SBICPSL will not entertain any correspondence or communication regarding this offer thereafter.
    * This Offer is a standalone Offer and the benefits offered under this Offer cannot be clubbed together and/or in any way be cumulated with any other offer of SBICPSL in any manner or form.

  * ### Exclusive Offer for newly onboarded and upgraded Cardholders of SBI Card ELITE American Express Card
    * Exclusive Offer for newly onboarded and upgraded Cardholders of SBI Card ELITE American Express Card
  *     * Cardholders who completes Digital Onboarding journey & avails any of the offer within 30 days from Digital Onboarding date, gets 100 Reward Points.
    * These reward points will be credited only once irrespective of no. of offers availed by the customer.
    * Points accumulated by a cardholder on the SBI credit card cannot be combined or used in conjunction with points of his/her other SBI credit cards at the time of redemption or transferred to any other customer loyalty program unless otherwise notified by SBICPSL (formerly known as SBI Cards and Payment Services Private Limited) (hereinafter referred to as SBI Card).
    * The points do not constitute property of the cardholder and are not transferable by operation of law or otherwise to any person or entity.
    * Adjustment will be made to the points if there are any credits, including those arising from returned goods or services or billing disputes. If a disputed transaction is resolved in favour of the cardholder or where transaction is reversed, proportionate points will also be reversed from the cardholder's account. On redemption the points would automatically be subtracted from points accumulated in the cardholder's account.
    * Points can only be accumulated for a period of 24 months from the date of the accrual of reward point under the rewards program. Any points not used by the end of the stipulated 24 months shall lapse and be forfeited.
    * In the event the SBI Card is voluntarily closed by the cardholder, the points accumulated on his/her SBI card account can be redeemed within 30 days of closure, otherwise these will automatically lapse. In the event of cancellation of the SBI Card for any other reason, all the points accumulated will stand forfeited, but may be reinstated at the discretion of SBICPSL if the use of SBI Credit Card is reinstated.
    * The SBI Credit Card must not be overdue, suspended, blocked, canceled or terminated by SBICPSL at the time of redemption request.
    * The points accrued can only be redeemed by the Primary Cardholder and not by an Additional Cardholder.
    * The Points may be redeemed at participating merchant establishment for a variety of rewards, as detailed in the program catalogue and other mailers issued by SBICPSL from time to time e.g. merchandise, shopping, dining, travel, fee waivers, financial services and credit card upgrades, however cannot be settled against any outstanding in the account pertaining to Govt. taxes & levies, Balance Transfer, EMI & Cash Withdrawal.”
    * Reward Points can only be redeemed in the multiple of 2,000 points unless or otherwise stated.
    * The points cannot be exchanged for cash or credit or used to obtain cash advances or used against payment for any charges incurred on the SBI card unless that is part of that particular SBI credit card's feature.
    * A fee of ₹ 99 plus Applicable Taxes will be debited to the card account per redemption request towards delivery and processing charges. The same will be charged to the Cardholder in his/her monthly statement.
Fraud and abuse relating to earning and redemption of points in the program will result in the forfeiture of the points as well as termination of the SBI credit card account. SBICPSL or its merchant establishments for administrative and/or marketing purposes may use information supplied by a Cardholder on the redemption of rewards.
In case any reward points have been wrongfully availed or erroneously awarded and if the same have been redeemed against statement outstanding by Cardholder, then it can be adjusted back as statement debit on the card account.
The reward points that are accrued on your Card account shall be immediately forfeited on the occurrence of any of the following events:
      * The Cardholder fails to make the Payment on the card which is due for a period greater than 90 days.
      * The Cardholder fails to make payment of the outstanding dues on its Card Account and opts for settlement of the outstanding payment due on the Card account.
      * The Cardholder is found to be involved in a fraud on its own Card account after an investigation is carried out by SBICPSL.
In the event that the Cardholder does not initiate any transaction on his card for a period of 13 consecutive months, the reward point balance shall be forfeited at the end of the 13th month.
In the event that the Cardholder misses two consecutive payments, the rewards points that were accrued during the first cycle for which payment was not made will be forfeited.
In the event of a voluntary closure of the Card account by the Cardholder, the unutilized reward point balance shall be forfeited after a period of 30 days from the date of closure of the Card Account.
Any taxes or other liabilities or charges payable to the government or any other authority or any participating merchant establishment which may arise or accrue to a cardholder by redemption as aforesaid or otherwise as a result of the program shall be to the sole account of the cardholder.
SBICPSL reserves the right to cancel, change or substitute the rewards or the rewards conditions or the computations of points or terms and conditions of the program anytime. SBICPSL can suspend or terminate the program any time it deems necessary. In such a case SBICPSL will intimate the cardholder and give them an option to redeem the accumulated points.
Products/Gifts/Vouchers/e-Vouchers once redeemed by the cardholder, shall not be cancelled.
SBICPSL makes no warranties or representations either expressed or implied with regard to the type, quality or fitness of the goods and services provide by the participating merchant establishment under the program.
The Program does not in any way amend the Cardholder agreement between SBICPSL and the cardholder and any term referenced but not defined herein may be interpreted in accordance with the cardholder agreement.
SBICPSL acts in good faith in response to any oral or electronic instruction or enquiry by the Cardholder in respect of any matter in relation to this program and fulfillment of any reward. The cardholder will not be entitled to claim or allege any loss, damage, liability, expense etc. attributable directly or indirectly, to any such good faith action of SBICPSL.
Any disputes arising out of the Offer between the Cardholder and SBICPSL shall be subject to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed by SBICPSL for this purpose. The proceedings of the arbitration shall be conducted as per the provisions of Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The place of arbitration shall be at New Delhi and language of arbitration shall be English. The existence of a dispute, if any, shall not constitute a claim against SBICPSL.
SBICPSL may engage, hire, use the services of agent(s) and/or any third party(ies) for the purpose of providing marketing or sales related services or any other related services in relation to its products on its behalf and the customer may be required to deal with such agents/third parties/service providers with respect to such product/services.

pages.markdown:
Effective 3rd Jan’23 Cardholders can set new Standing Instructions (e-Mandate based recurring transactions) at SBI Card channels (Mobile App and Website) as per the regulatory guidelines.
With SBI Card’s Auto Bill Pay, register all your bills at one place and SBI Card will ensure they are paid on time. You don't have to worry about keeping your billing deadlines in mind.
  * You can now pay your telephone, mobile, electricity bills, and insurance premiums on time.
  * Register your billers and set standing instructions to pay your bills on time everytime, automatically.
  * Get SMS and e-mail alerts on new biller additions, bill due dates and payment information.

  * To register,. Post login, click on the 'Bill Payments' tab on the left navigation bar.
  * Set Auto Bill Pay for the biller you have added.
  * Alternatively, you can call on our helpline: 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD code, if you are calling from your mobile). Please call 1860 180 1290, if you are calling from BSNL or MTNL lines.

pages.markdown:
Plan for your holidays, celebrations, education and more with SBI Card Encash. Enjoy hassle-free fund transfer with convenient repayment options.
  * Encash offer will be over and above your credit limit
  * Encash Inline offer will be within your existing credit limit

  * Get money credited directly in your bank account within 3-4 working days with NEFT Facility

  * A rate of interest as per existing offer is applicable
  * A one-time processing fee of 2%, minimum of Rs. 499 a maximum of Rs. 3,000 will be levied
  * In case of foreclosure of your Encash booking, a 3% foreclosure fee on the outstanding principal amount will be charged

Encash / Encash Inline is a pre-approved, money-on-demand facility, which is offered to a select set of SBI Credit Cardholders. The Encash / Encash Inline amount that a cardholder would be eligible for can be over and above the existing Credit Limit or within the existing Credit Limit on the cards. The funds will be transferred to the bank account of the cardholder within 3-4 working days from booking confirmation.
