With YONO, You Only Need One app for all your banking, shopping and investment needs. YONO is your one stop shop to fulfil all your banking, insurance, investments, and daily shopping needs.
  * - Open a digital savings account in less than 5 minutes without leaving your home and get personalized platinum debit card, Concession on Bank service charges & Paperless
  * - Exclusive discounts and offers for SBI customers across a large number of e-commerce merchants
  * - Easy to understand interface, Simple and intuitive navigation
  * - Link and view all State Bank group relationships (Bank and all JVs) in one app
  * - Intelligent spending analysis using smart auto-tagging and categorization of the transactions
  * - Pre-approved personal loans on the go up to 1 lakh without any documentation in 2 minutes

**Q1. How can I contact Yono customer care? I am facing technical issues (unable to login/register) on the app/portal.**
You can find the customer care number details from 'Contact Us' option under 'Support' option. In addition to this you may reach us via following ways:

After you successfully download the Yono app, you can explore/shop from our marketplace and other financial products and open digital savings account. Existing SBI customer can use their online SBI login credentials to directly register the app and login.
**Q3. How do I log on to the Yono app/portal?**
You can log on to the Yono app/portal with your online SBI login credentials or account details including ATM Card. On the mobile app, you can set up a 6-digit MPIN that can be used for login in future. In case you do not have both your online SBI login credentials and ATM card, please visit your SBI branch.
MPIN is a 6 digit numeric code which is used to login into the app.
**Q1. How can I link my SBI Credit Card to YONO mobile App/ web Portal?**
To link youron YONO, you need to have your mobile phone number that you have registered with SBI Card.
  * Step 1: Go to the Credit Card section of YONO and click on ‘Link SBI Credit Card’
  * Step 2: Enter the username & password you use to log on to sbicard
  * Step 3: Click on Send OTP and enter the OTP received on your registered mobile no.

You have successfully linked your SBI Credit Card(s) to the YONO.
**Q2.I have forgotten my user ID or password for my SBI Card online account. What do I do now?**
To reset your online account password, Click on 'Link SBI Credit Card' on 'My Relationships' page. You have links to register new and also to reset your id and password.
  * Step 1: Click on ‘Forgot User ID or Password’ below the login button. It will take you to SBI Cards website.
  * Step 2: Enter your Card number, CVV, Date of Birth, and ‘Generate OTP’
  * Step 3: Validate the OTP sent on your the registered mobile number

**Q3.I have an SBI Credit Card but I haven’t registered it online. How can I do that now?**
If you do not have a user ID, Click on 'Link SBI Credit Card Link' on 'My Relationships' page. You have links to either register new or to reset id/password.
  * Click on “Register”. It will redirect you to SBI Cards website.
  * Enter your SBI Card no., CVV no. & Date of Birth
  * Your One Time Password (OTP) will be sent on your registered mobile no. & e-mail id. This OTP is valid for 30 min. or one successful usage
  * Enter your OTP correctly to set your user id & password and complete the registration process

**Q4. I have started the linking process but have not received the OTP yet?**
Please ensure that your mobile number & e-mail id is correctly registered with SBI Card. If your details are updated, you may be facing some network issue on your mobile phone connection. Please click on ‘Re-send OTP’ link on the screen to have the OTP re-sent to you.
**Q1. My current mobile no. is different from the one registered for SBI Credit Card. How can I change it?**
If your old registered mobile number is active, login to our website: sbicard.com and follow these steps:
  * Click on 'Quick Contact’ then click on blue colored edit icon next to the right hand side of the mobile number

If your old registered mobile number is Inactive, you can send the following documents:
  * Written & signed application for change in contact number, mentioning the 16 digit card number and the new mobile number.
  * Anyone of the following self-attested documents:

Please e-mail the above documents to contactchange@sbicard.com or courier/post them to SBI Cards & Payment Services Pvt Ltd, P.O. Bag No. 28, GPO, New Delhi- 110001.
**Q2. How to change my registered mobile number with SBI credit cards?**
If your old registered mobile number is active, login to website: sbicard.com and follow these steps:
  * Click on 'Quick Contact’ then click on blue colored edit icon next to the right hand side of the mobile number

to watch demoORLogin to our, follow these steps:
  * Click on menu tab that is on the top left hand side of the app screen
  * Click on yellow colored edit icon next to mobile number
  * Go to quick contact & Click on yellow colored edit icon next to mobile number. Then enter the right mobile number

If your old registered mobile number is Inactive, you can send the following documents:
  * Written & signed application for change in contact number, mentioning the 16 digit card number and the new mobile number.
  * Anyone of the following self-attested documents:

Please e-mail the above documents to contactchange@sbicard.com or courier/post them to SBI Cards & Payment Services Pvt Ltd, P.O. Bag No. 28, GPO, New Delhi- 110001.
You can change your Mailing/ Non-Mailing Address either through the website or by calling theTo change address using the Website:-
  * Enter the One Time Password sent on your registered mobile no.

To change address using the Mobile App:Login to our, follow these steps:
  * Click on menu tab that is on the top left hand side of the app screen
  * Click on yellow colored edit icon just below your name & go to address option
  * Click on yellow colored edit icon next to the address and enter the new address
  * Enter the OTP received on registered number and click on ‘Submit’

To change Address using the HelplineCall the SBI Card Helpline number: 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD Code) for any address change update.
  * Any change in the residence address requires a self–attested physical/scanned copy of the current address proof (Please for the list of KYC documents)
  * If proof of current residence address is not available, then please provide the below documents:-
  * Address Change Declaration Form/letter mentioning the current address. (Declaration form is updated on the SBI Card website)
  * Kindly mention the 16 digit card number on mail or letter/ declaration form and send it to email ID addressproof@sbicard.com or courier it at the postal address given below:

SBI Cards & Payment Services Pvt. Ltd. SBI Card (KYC Address Change), DLF Cyber City, Tower-C, Block 2 ,Building 3, DLF Infinity Towers, 12th Floor, Gurgaon-122002 (Haryana)
**Q4. How do I make my SBI Credit Card payment using YONO?**
You can pay your SBI Card outstanding from your SBI transaction account on YONO using the following steps:
  * Step 1: Go to the Credit Card section of YONO and click on the card you wish to make payment for
  * Step 2: On 'My Relationships' page, click on 'Pay now'
  * Step 3: Select the SBI account you wish to make the payment from
  * Step 4: Select the amount you wish to make the payment for. You can pay the entire outstanding amount, the minimum amount due or any other amount you wish to pay

**Q1. I have lost my Credit Card, what steps do I need to take?**
In case of a, you need to report it to SBI Card at the earliest. This can be done either through YONO mobile App/web Portal, SMS, SBI Card Website or IVR:You need to go to the credit cards section of YONO mobile App/ web Portal. In the card summary page you have options of services. Choose block lost or stolen card. Choose the credit card to block and you may opt to reissue by clicking on reissue tab.
In case you remember your card number, you can block your card by sending an SMS from your registered mobile number in the below format:
You will receive a block confirmation via SMS. In case you do not receive a block confirmation, please call the SBI Card helpline 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD Code).
To report Lost/Stolen credit card on Website: Log onto sbicard.com and follow these steps:
  * Click on Login button and enter your username and password to log into your account
  * Click on the ‘Report Lost/Stolen Card’ under the ‘Requests’ tab present on the left hand side menu
  * If you want to get the card re-issued, click ‘Submit’
    * Call on the SBI Card helpline 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD Code) & select your preferred language.

To raise a transaction dispute, you can call SBI Card helpline 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (Prefix local STD Code) or email us at chargeback@sbicard.com
**Q2. What is the time frame to report Credit Card Transaction Dispute?**
Transaction dispute needs to be reported in writing within 70 days from the statement date in which the said transaction appears.
**Q1. What are the Fees applicable on my Credit Card?**
Please visit SBI card website T&C and charges page for this data. https://www.sbicard.com/en/tnc.page
**Q2. How do I change transaction PIN for Credit Card?**
You can generate transaction PIN for your credit card by going to SBI cards section of YONO mobile App/ web Portal.To generate transaction PIN, login to your online account and click on 'My Credit cards’ tab and follow these steps:
  * Select the card for which pin needs to be changed

To generate transaction PIN through IVR:Call on SBI Card Customer Helpline number: 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (Prefix local STD Code)
  * Step 2. Enter the 16 digit SBI card number, DOB in DD MM YYYY & Card expiry date in MM YY format
  * Step 3. Enter the 6 digit OTP received on your registered mobile number or email address
  * Step 4. Choose a 4 digit PIN number and re-confirm
  * Step 5. You will get a confirmation message on the IVR itself

**Q3. What is the process of applying for an SBI Card?**
You can visit SBI Credit Cards page on YONO mobile App/ web Portal and you have three options for you to take you to apply journey. You can either accept the recommended card that is specifically recommended to you based on your spend pattern. You may use our simplifier to help you choose a card or straight away pick a card from the list of cards using 'browse cards'. When you decide on a card, you may apply for the card.
**Q4. How can I find out which SBI Card I am eligible for?**
Visit the ‘Help me find the perfect card’ section on YONO mobile App/ web Portal to find out which SBI Card will be best suited for you. The recommendation is based on your needs and spending patterns.
**Q5. I could not find my town or city name in the city dropdown menu in the online form. How can I apply?**
SBI Card serves in select locations across India through its online application service. If you do not see your city in the dropdown, please call SBI Card helpline at 39 02 02 02 (please prefix the STD code of your city) or visit your nearest SBI branch.
**Q6. What is the process of earning Reward Points on a card? How many points do I earn per transaction?**
The number of reward points earned per transaction depend on the type of card you own. To know the Reward Point offered by different cards, please visit the Rewards section of our sbicard.com website.
Once you link your card, you may visit the Credit Card section of the YONO mobile App/ web Portal for details of the reward points available on your card.
**Q8. How can I redeem the reward points on my card?**
There is a link available in the rewards section of Credit Cards section . Log on to YONO mobile App/ web Portal and visit the Reward section. You can choose amongst hundreds of products from our Reward Catalogue to redeem the reward points available on your card.
**Q9. Can I add the reward points I have on multiple cards or transfer them from one card account to another?**
No, you cannot add or transfer your Reward Points from one SBI Card to another. Reward points can be redeemed only on SBI Card on which they have been earned.
**Q10. Do the Reward Points accrued on my card expire?**
Yes, you can accumulate your points only for a period of 24 months from the date of the accrual under the Shop & Smile Rewards Program. Any points not redeemed by the end of the stipulated 24 months from the date of accrual will lapse. You can know the number of Reward Points that are expiring in a particular month by logging on to YONO mobile App/ web Portal. This information is also mentioned in your monthly statement.
**Q11. Can I redeem my reward points once my SBI Card is closed?**
No, you cannot redeem your reward points after the closure of your card account.
**Q1. Can I delink my cards from YONO mobile App/ web Portal?**
If you have your cards linked in the YONO mobile App/web Portal, you can see a link 'Delink SBI Credit Card'. Clicking on this button will prompt the customer that all credit card related information will be delinked from the system. Once he agrees the cards will be delinked from the YONO mobile App/ web Portal. Once delinked, he can link again if needed.
**Q1. Can I reissue my card through the mobile App/ web Portal if I have not blocked the card through YONO mobile App/ web Portal?**
No. If you block a card in YONO mobile App/ web Portal, you can reissue in the app/Portal. If the card is not blocked in YONO mobile App/ web Portal, the customer may try to have his card reissued from SBI Cards website.
**Q1. I have made payment towards my card outstanding through YONO mobile App/ web Portal but on 'My Relationships' it is still showing my billed amount.**
The payment made is reflected in your Card summary page when you click on the card number on 'My Relationships' page under 'My Credit Cards' section. The Total outstanding will be reduced to the extent payment is made. The available balance also increases accordingly.
**Q2. What is Total outstanding? Why do I see amount in Total outstanding even after I paid the billed amount on YONO mobile App/ web Portal?**
The Total outstanding is the total amount of billed and unbilled transactions. Billed amount constitutes of the payable amount as on latest statement date. Unbilled transactions are the transaction since the latest billing which constitutes the unbilled outstanding.
**Q3. Why am I not able to view the payment made in the transaction history just after my payment is done on YONO mobile App/ web Portal? How much time does it take to reflect in transaction history on YONO mobile App/ web Portal?**
The payment made and other unbilled transactions on YONO mobile App/ web Portal will appear in the transaction history post settlement of the file and this process takes from 2 to 5 days.
**Q4. I made a payment on YONO mobile App/ web Portal, however my outstanding has not decreased and available amount has not increased.**
In an unforeseen case of this event occurring, please check your debit account if the amount has been debited. Please note down the reference number from the narration. The transaction will automatically be posted in the next 24-48 hours and a confirmation from SBI Cards team is sent through SMS on mobile number which you have registered with SBI Cards.
**Q5. I made a transaction through SBI Card on YONO mobile App/ web portal but I can’t find the transaction in the transaction history.**
All transactions are visible in the transaction history post settlement. So unbilled transactions take 24-48 hours to appear in the transaction history. The outstanding of unbilled however updates instantly and may be verified.

Once you apply for an SBI Credit Card, your eligibility is assessed based on multiple parameters. There are certain basic criteria that all applicants must fulfil. These are:
  * Banking Relationship - Not mandatory, but may improve approval chances
  * Credit Score - Good credit score, preferably between 750 and 900
  * Location - Applicant's residence address should be in locations serviced by SBI Card

To apply for a credit card online, you will need the following documents:
  * Copy of Aadhaar Card (with first 8 digits masked) or any valid government address proof for Digital KYC
  * Other documents like your income documents - Salary slip, income tax return, etc. (In Physical or Digital form) may be required depending upon the credit card eligibility & policy. For complete list and details of valid KYC documents,

Check the status or continue your SBI Credit Card Application
Applying for an SBI Credit Card on our Website is very simple:
  * Visit the 'Credit Cards' page on our Website and choose a card from the category that best fits your requirements.
  * Click on 'Apply Now' and fill in the E-Apply Form / Online Application Form.
  * Click 'Submit' and you will receive an instant decision on the application basis the information provided.
  * If your application is approved, you will receive a call from the SBI Card Team for verification.
  * Post necessary verification, the card will be issued to you.

You can also apply for an SBI Credit Card directly from the E-Apply page (Online Credit Card Application page) on the Website.

* You can only if you are eligible for it.

* Follow the steps given on the Card Upgrade page and submit the request to upgrade to a new card.
What is the difference between a credit card and a debit card?
Credit cards give you access to a line of credit issued by the credit card issuer, while debit cards deduct money directly from your bank account.
What are cobrand credit cards and what are the different cobranded credit cards that SBI Card offers?
Cobrand credit cards are the credit cards launched in partnership with other brands to offer special discounts and deals. SBI Card offers various cobrand credit cards with brands such as BPCL, IRCTC, Landmark, etc.

A credit card is an instrument that allows you to make instant purchases for various goods & services, for which you can pay later. Every credit card account is assigned a credit limit and you can utilise the card till the assigned limit. Once you make the payment at the end of the pre-specified credit period, your credit limit will be restored. Unlike a debit card which is linked directly to your bank account, credit card offers the flexibility to make transactions, independent of the balance available in your bank account.

Get your dues deducted directly from your bank account, on the payment due date.

  * Make payments anytime, at your convenience from any bank account (Except SBI) that offers the NEFT facility.

  * Step 1: Log in to the net banking facility of your bank. Add SBI Card as a beneficiary under third party transfer.
  * Step 3: Enter your 16-digit SBI Credit Card number in place of account number on the banking page
  * Step 4: Select Beneficiary Account type as ‘Credit Card Payment’ or ‘Savings Account’
  * Step 5 : Click ‘Submit’ button to complete your registration process.**Payment will reflect instantly in your SBI Credit Card account.**

  * Make SBI Card payment anytime, anywhere, using or net banking facility of over 50 banks across India.

  * Step 1 : Log in tousing your SBI Card online user ID and password
  * Step 2 : Click on ‘Pay now’ on the Dashboard page
  * Step 3 : Select the amount you wish to make the payment
  * Step 4 : Select the mode of payment and the Bank name from the drop down menu
  * Step 5 : Confirm the details and be securely re-directed to your bank’s payment interface to authorise the payment. Your account will get debited online and you will receive an online transaction confirmation with a Transaction Reference Number which will also be sent on your registered mobile no. and e-mail id.

  * Step 1 : Clickto proceed to Paynet-Pay Online. Enter details of the SBI Card number, e-mail ID, phone number and the amount you wish to pay

  * Step 3 : Enter your net banking authentication details, i.e. user ID password, etc.
  * Step 4 : Confirm the amount to be paid. Your account will get debited online and you will receive an online transaction confirmation with a Transaction Reference Number
  * You will also receive an e-mail acknowledgement of your transaction on the e-mail ID provided by you.**Payment will reflect instantly on your SBI Credit Card account**

  * Step 3 : Select a date range to check status of payments made during the selected period or search with the Transaction id

  * Step 3 : Fill in the sender and recipient details to initiate fund transfer.
  * Step 4 : After entering the details, click on ‘Confirm’ transaction.Once you confirm the transaction, the amount will be debited from your account and the payment will be scheduled to your card.**Payment will reflect instantly in your SBI Credit Card account.**

  * To link your SBI Credit Card on YONO, you need to have your registered mobile phone number.

  * Select the amount and click on “Pay Now” to complete your payment

metadata.title: RBI Tokenisation | Credit Card Tokenization for Safe Payments | SBI Card
metadata.description: Tokenisation is a process in which a unique alternate card number, or ‘Token’ is created in place of card’s 16-digit number, that helps to make safe credit card payments.
metadata.keywords: tokenisation, card tokenisation, tokenization rbi, rbi tokenization, payment tokenisation, credit card tokenisation, card tokenization rbi, rbi card tokenization

pages.markdown:
Tokenisation is the process of replacing a card’s 16-digit number on the plastic card with a unique alternate card number, or ‘Token’ which shall be unique for a combination of card, token requestor and device. Tokens can be used for online transactions, mobile point-of-sale transactions or in-app transactions. This token contains no personal information that can be directly accessed and keeps changing making it the most secure method to complete payments. OTP authentication will continue as an additional layer of protection. Some merchants may continue to ask for CVV but it will not be used for authentication of transactions. Merchant processes are not governed by SBI Card
  * More secured transactions with no data stored at merchants’ Website / App
  * Faster checkouts as card details like 16-digit Card Number, Name, Expiry and CVV are not required to be re-entered

RBI has directed the payment aggregators, wallets and online merchants (entities in card transaction/payment chain other than card issuers/card networks) not to store any sensitive card related customer information including full card details. Hence, the card numbers can be replaced with ‘token’ as mentioned above. This RBI mandate would come into effect from 1st October 2022. Please be assured that this will not hamper your credit card experience but will make your credit card transactions more secure.
### What happens to my saved cards from 1st October 2022?
As the card details will not be saved from 1st October 2022 you will need to tokenise your card on the corresponding Merchant website or app. You can then continue to make payments without entering your card details again on that Merchant if you have generated a token. If you do not tokenise your card, then you would have to manually enter your full card details for making transactions
This token will be used instead of your card details for all the online payments you make on the merchants.
A tokenised card transaction is considered safer as the actual card details are not shared/stored with the merchants to perform the transaction.
You should follow the instructions specified by the online Merchant and follow the registration and verification flow in order to register for tokenisation and store the token with the online Merchant. Generally, the process would entail filing your card details, followed by verification via OTP and then a token will be generated associated with your card. This token will be saved by the online Merchant.
If you do not choose to tokenise your card then you will have to enter all your card details including card number, expiry and CVV for every payment you make.
### Can my token on one merchant be used for another?
No, token registered on one merchant cannot be used on another merchant. Each merchant will have a unique token associated with every card saved on that Merchant. This token cannot be used for any other card that you might have or on any other merchant. Essentially, your card will have multiple tokens based on the number of Merchant you would have tokenised your card with.
You can delete token by directly going to the merchant’s website/app and deleting the card associated with the token from your payment preferences. Alternatively, you can also call SBI Card’s helpline to request for deletion.
### Is there any limit on the number of cards that I can request for tokenisation?
You can request for tokenisation of any number of cards to perform a transaction.
### Can I select which card to be used in case I have more than one card tokenised?
For performing any transaction, you will be free to use any of the cards registered with the token requestor / merchant.
### Once tokenised, how will I get to see the card details on the merchant page?
You will be able to see the last 4 digits of the card on the merchant page.
### What will happen to the token once my card (including Add-On card) gets replaced or renewed or reissued or upgraded?
You will have to visit the merchant page and create a fresh token by following the instructions available on the merchants’ page.
### Will the Add-On card holder also need to tokenise his/her card, in case the primary card holder has already tokenised his/her primary card?
Yes, Add-On card holder will need to tokenise his/her card separately following the same process as the primary card holder.

pages.markdown:
At SBI Card we pledge to give our customers the maximum and most premium benefits. Presenting SBI Card Elite with premium features like complimentary movie tickets, complimentary airport lounge access, complimentary membership Club Vistara & Trident privilege, earn upto 50,000 reward points every year. To know more about SBI Card Elite Credit Card, visit: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/lifestyle/sbi-card-elite.page
Enjoy unlimited privileges with your Simply SAVE SBI Card. Register for a SimplySAVE SBI Card & earn upto 10x Reward Points on dining, groceries, and movies! Save while spending on fuel & get 2000 bonus reward points. Know everything about your SimplySAVE SBI Card at: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/shopping/simplysave-sbi-card.page
Make online shopping more rewarding with the SimplyCLICK SBI Credit Card. Avail 5X Reward points on all online shopping & 10X Reward Points with our exclusive partner: Amazon.in, BookMyShow, Cleartrip, Dineout, Lenskart, Netmeds & Urban Company. To know more about SimplyCLICK SBI Card, visit: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/shopping/simplyclick-sbi-card.page
"Doctor's SBI Card - An exclusive credit card that offers insurance cover of up to 20 lakhs* to doctors. Insurance covers legal & defense costs, along with the expenses incurred on court proceedings. SBI Card has announced its partnership with Indian Medical Association (IMA) to offer an exclusive credit card, titled as Doctor’s SBI Card. The card with the same name is also offered without any association with the IMA. Both the cards offer professional indemnity insurance cover to the tune of ₹20 lakhs* to protect doctors against professional risks and liabilities. The cover includes legal & defense costs, out of court settlements and court awards. Know everything about Doctor’s SBI Credit Card at: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/lifestyle/doctors-sbi-card.page. *Professional Indemnity Cover of 10 Lakh is now Enhanced to 20 Lakh, T&C Apply. "
"SBI Card launched Etihad Guest SBI Card in collaboration with Etihad Airways especially travel enthusiasts. With Etihad Guest SBI Credit Card, unlock a world of amazing travel benefits like air miles, international and domestic lounge access, booking discounts and more. To know more about the features, benefits and rewards offered by the card, visit: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/travel/etihad-guest-sbi-card.page. Apply now at: https://www.sbicard.com/eapply/eapply-form.page?path=personal/credit-cards/travel/etihad-guest-sbi-card.dcr#/ #MakeLifeSimple #MoreMiles #StepCloserToExclusivity #EtihadGuest #EtihadGuestSBICard"
"Give your Fuel Spends some Extra* mileage with BPCL SBI Card. BPCL SBI Credit Card is an international credit card and can be used at over 24 million outlets worldwide. To know more about the features, benefits and rewards offered by the card, visit: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/travel/bpcl-sbi-card.page #BPCLSBICard #BPCLFuelCard #SBIFuelCard"
"Club Vistara SBI Card PRIME is the latest travel credit card launched recently by SBI Card in partnership with Club Vistara. TAKE OFF WITH REWARDS. LAND WITH EXPERIENCES. With an array of indulgences carefully crafted and meticulously curated around you, your travel experience is about to get truly fulfilling. So sit back, relax, enjoy and make most of the delights and privileges that await you with Club Vistara SBI Card PRIME. Privileges on Club Vistara SBI Card PRIME - Welcome Gift - Reward Benefits - Milestone Benefits - Comprehensive Insurance Cover - Domestic Airport Lounge access - Complimentary Priority Pass Membership To know more features, benefits and rewards, visit: https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/travel/club-vistara-sbi-card-prime.page #MakeLifeSimple #LiveItUp #ClubVistaraSBICardPRIME #ClubVistaraSBICard #TravelwithSBICard #TravelCard"
"Journeys are meant to be enjoyed, and the IRCTC SBI Card Premier is here to help you do just that! So, get your card, book your travel, avail exciting offers and make your journey all that it can be and more. Save 1.8% transaction charges on railway ticket bookings and book your airline tickets with IRCTC at unbeatable prices with IRCTC SBI Card Premier. To know more about the benefits, features, rewards, fees and charges of the IRCTC SBI Card Premier, visit https://www.sbicard.com/en/personal/credit-cards/travel/irctc-premier-card.page Apply Now at: https://www.sbicard.com/en/eapply.page"

pages.markdown:
Manage your account on the go with the SBI Card Mobile App
      * SBI Card was launched in 1998 by the State Bank of India and GE Capital. Incorporated as SBI Cards and Payment Services Private Limited (SBICPSL), SBI Card is headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana.
In December 2017, State Bank of India and The Carlyle Group acquired GE Capital`s stake in SBI Card.The company changed its legal name to SBI Cards and Payments Services Limited in August 2019. In March 2020, SBI Card became the first pure play credit card company to list on the stock exchanges in India.
The aim of SBI Card is to offer Indian consumers access to a wide range of world-class, value-added payment products and services. Our endeavor is to simplify the lives of our customers, employees and other important stakeholders.
Our innovative products and services along with our responsible corporate citizenship practices form the framework of delivering on this promise.
Within a short span of 10 months from inception, we achieved a credit card customer base of 1 lakh. We entered the '1Million Card Club’ in 2002 and crossed the 2 million card base in 2005.
Today, with over 21.8 million credit cards¹ in force, we are the second largest credit card issuer in the country.
      * In a span of over 27 years, we have achieved numerous milestones. We have significantly increased our card base, added new types of cards and received various awards and recognitions for our performance, quality and service.
        * We are the second largest credit card provider in the country, with a base of over 21.8 million cards in force.
        * We have a wide range of credit cards catering to diverse customer segments and changing customer needs. This includes, super premium card, premium cards, travel and shopping cards, classic cards, exclusive co-branded cards as well as corporate cards.
        * Our dedicated and customer-oriented approach has won us various industry accolades for customer service, branding, product innovation and marketing.

We do what is right, not what is easiest. We are honest and ethical in all that we do, at all times and in every situation.
We honour our commitments. To customers, to employees, to partners and to society. We say what we mean and we mean what we say.
We treat others as we expect to be treated; with respect, dignity and honour. Especially when things go wrong.
We challenge convention and pursue our convictions. Irrespective of the outcome, we always own our decisions and choices.
Customers are at the heart of all our choices. We understand that we exist because of our customers and the privilege to serve them has to be earned every day.
We hire high potential people and invest in their growth. SBI Card has a culture of continuous learning. Our training programs are thoughtfully designed to enable employees to enhance their skills and reach their full potential. We invest in employees’ education, and combine it with coaching and mentoring opportunities. Frequent leadership interactions further help to ensure well rounded professionals all around us.
Our approach to learning is guided by our commitment to enhance the leadership qualities in SBI Card employees. The learning processes also facilitate alignment to our core values. Our learning programs include world class leadership, functional and business specific trainings to our employees. Employees also get opportunities to develop new skills and deliver in competitive environment by working on various cross functional projects as well.
Developing and defining the career path for employees is deep rooted in the culture of SBI Card. We have well defined processes that can help employees proactively plan their career. Pathfinder, our career path guide, helps employees to find the right opportunities and create a personalized career plan. It provides guidance on various enablers that employees can leverage to realise their aspirations.
SBI Card strongly believes in fair employment practices. We are committed to prohibit all forms of discrimination against our employees and provide them with equal and fair treatment. We follow the detailed guidelines drafted as part of our fair employment practices as the basis of our effort towards ensuring equal opportunities for all our employees.
At SBI Card, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. We believe that diversity is a journey and we will continue to evolve and align practices to provide inclusive opportunities. Our diversity programs focus on gender diversity and creating opportunities for the differently abled. It is our constant endeavor to foster greater levels of inclusion by extending the diversity programs to include a more diverse workforce.
It's inspiring to work for a company that honestly wants to do right for its customers and employees and that is one of my many reasons to be associated with SBI Card for the past 2 decades.
I joined SBI Card as an associate in Pune and was truly scared to step into the corporate world! After I got married, I took a transfer to Gurugram office since then there has been no looking back as I brought up my two children, now teenagers beautifully alongside my career as I gradually scaled heights along with the growth of the company. This was all possible only with the support and flexibility this organization has provided. The culture of care and commitment is indeed praiseworthy and is reinforced from the top-down, as it starts with the senior management team. The leadership team here is a group of people who are refreshingly down-to-earth, approachable, and caring.
SBI Card gives immense opportunities to exercise our abilities, reaffirm ourselves and contribute towards the growth of the organization. I am privileged to work for SBI Card which supports us in setting our professional goals and guides us in our careers.
Indeed, I feel very proud to be one of the oldest employees at SBI Card!
### Sweta Palan, Deputy Vice President – Open Market & Corporate Sales
It has only been 13 years and I have had the opportunity to perform in 3 challenging roles and have had the unique opportunity to grow and develop under 7 dynamic leaders. It has been a very exciting journey and SBI Card has helped in breaking the glass ceiling.
The organization has offered seamless support in self-development, role enhancement, career growth and encouragement through reward & recognition, Work Life Balance. I would love to serve the organization with the same zeal for probably another decade!
It has been an exuberating journey with SBI Card for the past 8 years. I assumed two different functions, two different locations, multiple assignments starting from field agency management, call center management and transition of a call center. These projects proved to be an enriching experience vis-a-vis learning and growth.
From managing a small collection agency to managing a big team of full-time employees I met with individuals who displayed great zest and were ready to go that extra mile to support business deliverables.
The values and culture of the organization ensure that employees are always empowered to take decisions or raise their voices without any fear.
A career of 8 years in SBI Card has been so glorious that a book can be published on it. I must say the uniqueness about the organization is the sheer sense of camaraderie; and the true care behind that. Respect for all environments here gives a strong reason to perform.
During my journey, I have seen people being rewarded for their efforts along with my own growth. I established 5 centers individually in different cities of the east region only with a strong culture of trust, decision-making authority, opportunity to learn from mistakes & accepting individual ideas into business development. The opportunity given at each step was so fascinating that work has become life’s beautiful gift. Employees come here to perform which gradually creates momentum for further enhancement and growth for the company as well as individuals.
My journey of 6 years with the SBI Card is full of inspiration and learning. I joined SBI Card in 2016 as Assistant Manager and was later promoted to Manager. Currently, I am handling the Social Media Team, and each day is a new day, full of challenges and possibilities. I feel proud to be associated with an organization that is continuously focusing on enhancing customer experience as well as Employee care. I am grateful for all the support I have received at SBI Card to grow and prosper as a professional.
Seven years with SBI Card has been truly a journey of learning and empowering with the core values. With a culture that encourages imagination and innovation at work, one does not just create change but lives the change every day.
I have had the good fortune of working with various functions like Operations and Collections within the organization. The opportunities provided me with the much-needed impetus to grow as a professional and imbibe critical skills that accelerate one towards excellence. SBI Card offers you the wings you need to fly high as a professional.

pages.title: TZARO Italian Genuine Leather Reversible Belt Black and Dark Tan - IQZPRLTH48RV
pages.description: This beautiful pure leather belt is a reversible belt. Made with Italian leather – this belt comes with a dark shade of Tan on one side and classic black on the other. Both the sides have a textured finish which is a distinct pattern of an Italian company. The belt has a dome shape – its slimmer on the edges which is primarily due to high -pressure attachment to ensure that the belt doesn’t open up. The edges have a smooth finish and carry a classic black tone. The nickel finish reversible buckle is designed to perform over the years. This can be opened to ensure that size can be shortened – if the need be. You can cut it from buckle side and reattach the buckle. The belt is 32 MM wide and its 43.5 Inches long [buckle edge to tip of belt], its length to center hole from buckle edge is 37.5 inches [there are total of 5 holes at a gap of 1 inch each]. The belt can be used for waist size 32 Inches to 40 Inches [factoring that the length can be reduced].The belt is covered with 3 months warranty against manufacturing defects. Damages due to rough handling or usage are not covered under warranty. The products will be serviced or replaced under the warranty terms. The servicing will be done at the central service center.

pages.title: WONDERCHEF Nigella Outer Lid Tri Ply Pressure Cooker 5L
pages.description: Nigella Pressure Cookers are premium quality cookers available in 304 Stainless Steel. The body has the perfect curvature, which makes it easy to stir the food prior to pressure cooking. Heavy tri-ply body transmits heat quickly and evenly, which saves fuel and prevents the food from burning or sticking to the bottom. Nigella Pressure Cookers by Wonderchef empower you to cook in a smart, safe and healthy way. Nigella Tri-Ply Pressure Cooker range from Wonderchef is made of high-quality 304 Stainless that does not react with food.Conventional Safety Valve is filled on top of the lid, it helps to release excess pressure when it rises beyond the safety level. The food-grade silicone gasket ring offers better grip & seal; it tends to live longer than Rubber Gasket because it doesn’t crack easily upon aging. Tri-Ply Combination of SS 304 + Aluminium + SS 430 makes it highly durable. Nigella Tri-Ply Pressure Cookers have cool-touch handles. Compatible with all cooktops including induction and easy to clean. They are dishwasher safe.

pages.title: Skullcandy Jib True Wireless (TWS) Earbuds
pages.description: Maybe you’re the kind of person who likes to keep things simple. Well, friend, you’re the reason we made Jib True. They’re perfectly straightforward with just the features you need and nothing that you don’t. Jib True earbuds automatically enter pairing mode the first time they power on. After that, they’ll quickly auto-pair with the last device you used. Simple controls let you adjust volume, skip tracks, take calls and activate an assistant (like Google or Siri) without ever touching your phone. Wondering if Jib True can handle an unexpected sprinkle during your outdoor adventure? You bet. They're test-rated against industry standards to shrug off water. Between listening to music or watching videos, you’re probably going to want to take a phone call now and then. That’s why we built Jib True with microphones in both earbuds for clean, clear calls.

Sigmastar Main Processor; 2 MP CMOS Image sensor; class-leading lens with Infra-Red filter; Captures more light for improved low light videos; Wide FOV to cover 4-6 lanes simultaneously. Superior low light performance by class A lenses, and unique Wide Dynamic Range (WDR) video system. Crystal clear full high definition video quality, high video quality even when driving at night. pages.title: Wonderchef Octavia Auto Glass Hob Top 3 Burner

The skid-proof feature of the hob-top ensures stability and a strong, well-balanced cooking surface.
